title: Fuzzer: `TabContainer.set_tab_icon` crashes Godot

### Steps to reproduce

Run this script:

```gdscript
extends Node

func _process(_delta: float) -> void:
	var _v1433 = TabContainer.new()
	_v1433.set_tab_icon(-1, DrawableTexture2D.new())
	get_tree().quit()
```

Or use the attached `mrp.zip`:

```
godot --headless --path mrp/ Node.tscn
```

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[mrp.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/29985961/mrp.zip)
